title: lmdb: manual unsafe impl Send/Sync suppresses compiler auto-derivation
description: crates/lmdb/src/lib.rs:35-38 manually implements unsafe impl Send for LmdbBlockDb and unsafe impl Sync for LmdbBlockDb. Both heed::Env<T> and heed::Database are already Send+Sync per heed's own impls, so the compiler would auto-derive Send+Sync for LmdbBlockDb. The manual impls are redundant and harmful: if heed ever weakens its Send/Sync impls (e.g. after a correctness fix), the manual declarations here silently override that regression guard. The correct approach: remove the manual unsafe impls and let the compiler derive them from the field types. If auto-derivation fails, that is the compiler correctly telling you the type is not safe to share.
